brief.name: Dr. Yasmin Madeh
brief.subtitle: Mental Health & Family Counseling Consultant • Member of the Arab Psychotherapists Union • Internationally Certified Marriage Coach
brief.description: My role is to help you live a better-quality life and build healthier relationships with yourself and others. I will help you make peace with yourself, overcome the past, see the bigger picture more clearly, and begin your journey toward positive change — for yourself and because of yourself.

credentials.doctorateValue: Mental Health — United Ford College, London, UK

header.title: Care that fits the shape of your life
header.description: Every track begins with an 80-minute intake assessment, then settles into a rhythm you choose.

individualTherapy.title: Individual Psychological Counseling
individualTherapy.description: Personalized individual sessions to help you understand yourself, manage emotional challenges, and build healthier coping strategies.

couplesFamily.title: Couples & Family Counseling
couplesFamily.description: Supportive sessions focused on improving communication, resolving conflicts, and building healthier family and relationship dynamics.

adolescentCare.title: Adolescent Counseling
adolescentCare.description: Age-appropriate psychological support for adolescents to help them navigate emotional, social, academic, and developmental challenges.

psychologicalAssessment.title: Psychological Assessment
psychologicalAssessment.description: Professional psychological assessments using validated tools to better understand emotional, behavioral, and psychological needs.

burnoutRecovery.title: Stress & Burnout Support
burnoutRecovery.description: Guidance to understand stress and burnout, restore emotional balance, and develop healthier boundaries and daily habits.

followUpAftercare.title: Follow-up & Continued Support
followUpAftercare.description: Ongoing follow-up sessions to support your progress, maintain positive changes, and address new challenges along the way.

header.title: Small practice. Serious standards.
header.description: No call centres, no rotating therapists. Just one clinician, a secretary who knows your name, and measurement that keeps everyone honest about progress.

continuity.title: One doctor, full continuity
continuity.description: You are never passed between clinicians. Same therapist, every session.

progress.title: Measured progress
progress.description: Standardised tests track change so improvement is visible, not guessed.

privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.description: Clinical notes are split into shared and private records. You control your data.

flexibility.title: Flexible sessions
flexibility.description: Meet on-site or remotely through a secure video consultation.

header.title: Validated assessments, plain-language results
header.description: Take a screening from your portal in minutes. Every result is reviewed with your doctor before conclusions are drawn.

anxiety.title: GAD-7 Anxiety Screening
anxiety.description: Seven questions measuring generalized anxiety severity over the last two weeks.

mood.title: PHQ-9 Depression Scale
mood.description: Standard screening instrument for depressive symptoms and severity.

stress.title: Maslach Burnout Inventory
stress.description: Assesses emotional exhaustion, depersonalisation and personal accomplishment.

marcus.name: Ahmed M.
marcus.review: I came in barely able to talk about my panic attacks. Two years later, I haven't had a single one in eight months. The gradual pace of therapy made a huge difference for me.

priya.name: Sara N.
priya.review: The test results dashboard made me feel like my progress was real and visible. When I saw my GAD-7 score drop from 17 to 6, I finally felt like there was clear proof that I was getting better.

elenaTom.name: Mohamed & Nour
elenaTom.review: Dr. Yasmin never took sides. She helped us understand each other and gave us a better way to talk about the same issue we'd been arguing about for six years.

header.title: Frequently asked questions
header.description: Still unsure or have a question?

sessionDuration.question: How long is a session?
sessionDuration.answer: Standard sessions are 50 minutes. Initial assessments take 80 minutes, while couples sessions last 75 minutes.

onlineSessions.question: Do you offer online sessions?
onlineSessions.answer: Yes. You can have your sessions securely through Google Meet if remote therapy is more convenient for you.

confidentiality.question: Will my information remain confidential?
confidentiality.answer: Absolutely. Your personal information and clinical records are stored securely and handled with strict confidentiality according to professional standards.

cancelReschedule.question: Can I cancel or reschedule my appointment?
cancelReschedule.answer: Yes. Please let us know at least 24 hours before your appointment if you need to cancel or reschedule without a fee.

psychologicalTests.question: Do psychological tests replace a diagnosis?
psychologicalTests.answer: No. Psychological assessments provide useful information to better understand your situation, but every result is reviewed with the psychologist before any conclusions are made.
